function.name: prepare_site_memory_handoff
function.description: Finish a user-requested move to a new conversation after saving necessary memory. Provide current read/write receipts for index.md and relevant notes; the server verifies their persisted hashes. continuation is a short next-step instruction, not a history summary. Preserve discussion versus implementation and the user's authorized scope; do not authorize another milestone. This tool does not create a conversation. Call last, then stop.

path.description: Exact valid ASCII Markdown filename from a read/write receipt; index.md must be lowercase.
